title: Before You Leave
content:
The two of them slowly got to their feet.

Neither of them spoke.

The cheerful laughter that had filled the mountains only a few hours ago had now been replaced by silence.

Together, they walked back down the hill and returned to their hotel.

As Siddu packed his luggage, Sneha quietly watched him.

Every folded shirt...

Every zipped bag...

Brought him one step closer to leaving.

Finally, they checked out of the hotel and began their journey to the airport.

The drive felt unusually quiet.

Neither of them knew what to say.

Soon...

They reached the airport.

Siddu picked up his luggage, and together they walked toward the entrance.

Just as Sneha tried to follow him inside, one of the security officers stopped her.

"Ma'am, your ticket, please."

Sneha smiled awkwardly.

"I... I'm not travelling."

The officer politely nodded.

"I'm sorry, ma'am. Only passengers are allowed beyond this point."

Sneha stopped where she was.

Siddu slowly turned around.

A gentle smile appeared on his face.

"So..."

"I guess this is goodbye."

He adjusted his backpack and looked at her.

"Wasn't there something important you wanted to tell me?"

Sneha's heart began to race.

This was her last chance.

If she stayed silent now...

She might never see him again.

She closed her eyes for a brief moment and took a deep breath.

Then she looked straight into Siddu's eyes.

"Thank you..."

"For every smile."

"For every memory."

"For caring about me."

"For being the best friend I could ever ask for."

Siddu smiled warmly.

"You don't have to thank me."

Sneha slowly shook her head.

"I do."

"Because..."

"You've become someone very special to me."

For a moment...

Neither of them spoke.

Then...

Gathering every bit of courage she had left, Sneha stepped forward.

She gently kissed Siddu on the cheek.

"I love you, Siddu."

The words came out softly...

Yet they echoed louder than anything else around them.

She immediately stepped back.

Her heart was pounding.

Siddu stood completely still.

His eyes widened in shock.

Words refused to leave his lips.

His mind went completely blank.

He simply stood there, staring at Sneha as though time itself had stopped.

"You don't have to answer."

"I just wanted you to know."

Before Siddu could gather his thoughts...

The announcement for boarding echoed throughout the airport.

He looked at Sneha one last time.

Then...

Slowly...

He picked up his luggage and walked toward the security gate.

More than once, he felt the urge to turn around.

Every step carried him farther away from her.

Even so, he forced himself to keep walking.

A few minutes later...

He was seated inside the airplane.

As the aircraft slowly moved toward the runway, his mind refused to stay quiet.

Every moment he had shared with Sneha replayed inside his heart.

Her smile...

Her laughter...

The way she looked at him...

The concern she showed...

The forehead kiss...

The kiss on his cheek...

And finally...

Her confession.

"I love you, Siddu."

He leaned back against his seat.

For the first time...

His heart was filled not with answers...

But with questions.

Meanwhile...

Outside the airport...

Sneha quietly watched the airplane disappear into the sky.

A single tear rolled down her cheek.

She smiled to herself.

At least...

This time...

Her heart had finally spoken.

Whether he would accept it...

Only time could answer.
